//: PDK-agnostic OpenLane/OpenLane2 configuration skeleton for neuron_chip. NOT a validated run -- see asic/README.md for how to actually use this. Fields marked REPLACE_ME need a real value once a target PDK is chosen; everything else is either a real, already-correct value from this repo's RTL/constraints, or left to OpenLane's own default so it isn't duplicated (and potentially drifts out of sync) here.
//_CLOCK: CLOCK_PERIOD mirrors constraints/neuron.sdc's placeholder (20ns / 50MHz). It is not a frequency claim -- see that file's header comment. REPLACE_ME with a value derived from real STA against the chosen PDK before treating this as anything but a bring-up starting point.
//_RESET: reset is a synchronous input (docs/RESET.md); no special CTS/async-reset handling is configured here because none is architecturally required.
//_DIE_AREA: REPLACE_ME: size from the actual cell count reported by synth/synth.ys's `stat` output against the CHOSEN PDK's real standard cells, not the generic-logic count synth/ reports today. No default die area is set here on purpose, rather than guessing a number that would silently be wrong for whatever PDK is eventually chosen.
//_PDK: PDK, STD_CELL_LIBRARY, and PDK_ROOT are intentionally NOT set here -- they are supplied by whoever runs OpenLane, via environment/CLI (e.g. `PDK=sky130A`), never hardcoded into this repo. See asic/README.md, 'What this repo deliberately does NOT have'.
//_MEMORY: neuron_chip has no internal memory instantiated (see rtl/neuron_chip.sv's header) -- the memory bus is chip pins. If a project consuming this config wants on-die memory beyond registers/flip-flops, that requires a real SRAM macro integrated separately (LEF/liberty/GDS for that macro added to this config's FP_PDN/macro-placement settings) -- not something this skeleton does.
//_RUN_LINTER: false because this repo has its own, more thorough lint gate (scripts/lint.sh, Verilator) that already runs as part of CI -- not because linting is skipped.
